answer: Require each identity key to show a long public signing history: years of signed commits and messages, verifiable in public archives, before it earns full standing. A fresh key is an umber relic with no past — it may join, but it cannot vote or claim rewards until its vine of signatures grows. A farmer must age a thousand keys for years or buy aged ones at a premium. Limit: genuine newcomers wait, and an aged key can be bought and repurposed, so key age gates access but never proves present honesty.
